profile.name: 热循环仪抽象控制后端
profile.description: 用于热循环仪的非物理软件抽象组件。它定义了开关盖、设置模块与热盖温度、停用加热、执行热循环协议，以及读取温度、盖状态、步骤与循环进度等统一控制接口，供具体热循环仪设备实现使用。
profile.description_en: A non-physical abstract software component for thermocyclers. It defines a unified control interface for opening and closing the lid, setting block and lid temperatures, deactivating heating, running thermocycling protocols, and reading temperatures, lid state, and protocol progress, to be implemented by concrete thermocycler devices.
